limitations: focused known presets; emulator GLES on host GPU, no physical TV performance claim
onDrawFrame plus glFinish; 360 frames; excludes capture/PNG I/O; emulator engine, not TV app fps
Guest process PSS excludes some host GPU allocations; correlated observations, not all GPU memory
Only eight selected RGB hashes, not all 480 frames; chaotic divergence can inflate MAE
Authored profile renders at1280x720; metrics downsample all profiles to1182x665; historical numbers may use different authored sizes
Frame300 full PNGs and center-quarter crops are exported; other full-frame links require retained raw build captures

metric_definition.acceptance: No fixed numeric acceptance threshold; all images require visual review
metric_definition.aggregation: equal mean across eight selected frames; luma/contrast ratios use means
metric_definition.contrast: population standard deviation of per-frame luma at common resolution
metric_definition.mae: mean absolute RGB error against same-frame authored reference at common resolution
metric_definition.sharpness: OpenCV default 3x3 Laplacian variance on native-size normalized luma; resolution-dependent
